sourceChecks.scope: Read via WebFetch + direct PDF pages 7-8 extraction. Confirmed this is Hockey Canada's Program of Excellence (elite U17/national-team level, (c) 2008), not a U13 document. Pages 7-8 state the four offensive/defensive team-play principles (Pressure, Puck Control/Stall-Contain, Support, Transition) and define 'Support - Offensive' (teammates away from the puck must be available as passing options) and 'Transition - Offensive' (moving quickly from defense to attack once the puck is recovered). This supports the general team-support/reset principle the scenarios teach, disclosed in the scenario's own 'use' field as a higher-bracket source adapted down, not literal U13 application, per lesson 13 (older/higher-bracket sources are acceptable when disclosed as adaptations).
